topic: platform_driver remove callback on a vintage tree (before the two-step remove migration)
q: On a 4.19-era BSP kernel, write the remove path of a platform driver that tears down what probe set up.
requires_tree: vintage BSP tree whose platform_driver has only int (*remove); on 6.3-6.12 .remove_new exists and on >= 6.11 .remove itself returns void

corruptions.why: 6.3+ transitional field, deleted again in 6.13. It is scaffolding for a two-step migration and is often copied as if it were the final shape.

forbidden: relying on a non-zero return from .remove to abort unbinding - the core ignores the value and the device is unbound regardless
rubric: Implements int (*remove)(struct platform_device *) and returns 0. Does not use .remove_new, which this tree does not have, and does not treat the return value as able to refuse removal.
